Name: Totally Real Spider Replacer
Author: thezEn39
Description:
[b][i]This mod is not meant to be used as an actual Arachnophobia-Friendly mod. It was only made as a joke for April Fools, if you are looking for an actual arachnophobia-friendly mod. Please check [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18849]popoko's Spider' Shrooms.
[/url][/i][/b]
What this mod does:
- Replaces Spiders with giant red letters saying "SPDR", this based on Lethal Company's own arachnophobia toggle.
- Replaces webs with small red letters saying "web", in the same manner as the toggle.

That's all it really does. Happy April Fools!
